args.query: Textual TUI app with a DataTable and key bindings

results.title: cryptography MultiFernet key ring with rotation
results.summary: Wrap cryptography's MultiFernet in a small key ring that encrypts with the newest key, still decrypts tokens from older keys, re-encrypts them with rotate(), and rejects tokens once their key is dropped, all tested offline.

results.title: Babel codemod: rename bindings and prune console.log
results.summary: Parse TypeScript with @babel/parser, rename identifier bindings through scope.rename, drop console.log calls with @babel/traverse, and emit code with @babel/generator while handling the ESM/CJS default-export interop offline.

results.title: Next.js App Router + Stripe webhook handler
results.summary: A Next.js route handler that verifies Stripe webhook signatures from the raw body and handles checkout.session.completed.

results.title: Verify JWTs against a JWKS with jose (RS256, key rotation) in Vitest
results.summary: Verify third-party RS256 access tokens (Auth0, Cognito, Clerk style) with jose's JWKS key sets, checking issuer, audience, expiry and key rotation, tested offline with a local JWKS.

results.title: Litestar app with advanced-alchemy and DTOs on SQLite
results.summary: A Litestar app wired to SQLAlchemy through the advanced-alchemy plugin, with separate read and write DTOs over aiosqlite, tested offline with litestar.testing TestClient.

results.title: Litestar app with DI, role guards and exception handlers
results.summary: A Litestar app with a dependency-injected repository, a role guard on DELETE, and a custom exception handler, tested offline with create_test_client and an in-memory fake.

results.title: Round-trip edit YAML with ruamel.yaml keeping comments and key order
results.summary: Load YAML with ruamel.yaml round-trip mode, mutate scalars, sequences and inserted keys in place, then dump it back with comments, quotes and key order intact.

results.title: bidict two-way maps, inverse views and duplicate key errors
results.summary: Use bidict and OrderedBidict as bidirectional maps, resolve key and value collisions with forceput and OnDup, and handle the dedicated duplication errors.

results.title: injector Modules, @provider, singleton scope and ClassAssistedBuilder
results.summary: Wire a small app with injector Modules, a @provider method, singleton-scoped services and ClassAssistedBuilder assisted construction, then override bindings with a test module.

results.title: Next.js 16 App Router route handler + Zod validation
results.summary: Validate JSON bodies and search params in a Next.js App Router route handler with Zod, returning typed 400s; tested by calling the handler with NextRequest.
